faq.q: What dental insurances do you accept?
faq.a: We are in-network with Delta Dental Premier, MetLife, Cigna, Guardian, Aetna, and Humana. We also offer affordable in-house membership plans.

faq.q: What should I do if a tooth was completely knocked out?
faq.a: Pick it up by the crown (do not touch the root), gently rinse with water, place it in a cup of cold milk or saliva, and come to our office immediately. Time is critical within 60 minutes.

faq.q: Do you offer sedation options for anxious patients?
faq.a: Yes! We offer nitrous oxide (laughing gas) and oral conscious sedation to ensure a completely painless, anxiety-free visit.
